title: The Fall of the Clocktower
text: The clocktower of Eagle's Hope is destroyed on the eve of the anniversary, and falls after midnight. The ground beneath it splits open, revealing a castle stretching down into the dark.
date: Eve of the Castle Fall anniversary

title: The Black Cloak Perimeter
text: The Black Cloak Order seals off the Sandwalker zone, taking control of the city in the days that follow.

title: Council Action: Quarantine the Reach
text: The council votes to formally quarantine the affected district until the anomaly can be understood.
